text_markup: Hosted counters do not count as "on" a player or as objects a player "has". They are not counted by abilities that check the number of counters on a player and cannot be affected by abilities that remove counters from a player.
text_plain: Hosted counters do not count as "on" a player or as objects a player "has". They are not counted by abilities that check the number of counters on a player and cannot be affected by abilities that remove counters from a player.

examples.text_markup: The Corp resolves the first subroutine on {card:Whitespace}, forcing the Runner to lose 3[c]. The Runner cannot lose credits hosted on their cards, even if they do not have 3[c] in their credit pool.
examples.text_plain: The Corp resolves the first subroutine on Whitespace, forcing the Runner to lose 3{c}. The Runner cannot lose credits hosted on their cards, even if they do not have 3{c} in their credit pool.

examples.text_markup: The Corp has a rezzed {card:Superdeep Borehole} with hosted bad publicity counters. When the Runner fills their bad publicity fund in {ref:step_initiation_bad_publicity}, they do not receive credits for the hosted bad publicity.
examples.text_plain: The Corp has a rezzed Superdeep Borehole with hosted bad publicity counters. When the Runner fills their bad publicity fund in step 6.9.1b, they do not receive credits for the hosted bad publicity.

examples.text_markup: The Corp plays {card:Scapegoat} to remove 2 bad publicity. They cannot remove bad publicity counters hosted on {card:Superdeep Borehole}.
examples.text_plain: The Corp plays Scapegoat to remove 2 bad publicity. They cannot remove bad publicity counters hosted on Superdeep Borehole.
